title: Two successive quotients reset binary encodings of fixed-dimensional interpretation steps

statement.quantifiers: Every fixed parameter-free finite-control FO+ordinary unary Hartig interpretation program P on binary input n>=2; intermediate dimensions <=K and fixed arities <=r=max(2,arity); S=max(input size,all source universes).
statement.assertion: A fixed binary-vocabulary2D program Q preserves halting,output and nonhalting, with max universe <=C_P(1+S)^(K*r). Automatic-equivalence-closure quotients give bounded target steps per source step; strict-congruence implementation uses an extra finite input-dependent loop with the same space bound.
assumptions: Canonical Enc(B): logical element sort D, one incidence per true source relation tuple and permanent control markers.
Every source quantifier and Hartig count relativizes to D, excluding incidence/descriptor/control sorts.
Source seed denotes least generated equivalence and relations use existential representatives.
Clean up old logical data/work and then duplicate incidence candidates at every macrostep.

inputs: Fixed program parameters and unchanged original binary input; ordinary unary Hartig only.
outputs: Constructive fixed binary2D compiler with polynomial peak-state expansion, not general bit-space equivalence.
interface.precision: Exact finite interpretation semantics; all final relations arity2, not a single-edge graph vocabulary.
costs: C_P,K,r and formula width depend on the fixed source program; growing program descriptions must be charged.
Strict congruence closure iterates domain-preserving relation squaring to fixed point, so bounded-time macrostep guarantee is conditional on automatic quotient convention.
Full formula generator was not executed; source scripts check finite semantic interfaces only.

proof_mechanism: Build markers parameter-free by equality-pattern quotient pairs on n>=2; tag logical copies and products with disjoint sorts.
Build candidate new logical tuples V and relation incidences J_R of size at most m^(K*r).
First quotient merges V through the source equality seed and existentially transports incidence coordinates; discard old D/incidences/work.
Second quotient merges incidences having equal decoded source tuples, restoring exactly one incidence per true tuple.
Next products use the new D only; boundary size C(1+|B_next|)^r prevents repeated exponentiation through stale ambient encodings.
For strict semantics close identity+seed+inverse by C<-C union C composed C before saturation/quotient, with no new vertices.
obstructions: Counting quotient descriptors is not counting source logical elements.
Naive one-quotient compilation leaves duplicate incidences and destroys reset bounds.
Faithful raw arity>=5 input startup cannot generically fit a first binary2D n² universe; query-complexity separation does not follow.
Relational fixed-vocabulary small states may be exhaustively hardcoded; arbitrary partial HF halting is not thereby decidable.
High-arity preencoding must charge input blowup and cannot retain unchanged exp(Omega(encoded size)) consequences.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Check reset invariants, logical-sort counts, quotient convention, binary-input size and fixed parameters; independently validate source hard-pair lower bound before an exponential-state corollary.

review.source_reported: Source independent internal reconstruction and semantic finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
